scripts.build:for-publish: npm run build:package && npm run build:colors && npm run build:fonts && npm run post-build
scripts.build:colors: parcel build neo/neo-scss/base/_colors.scss --dist-dir ../neo-npm-package/neo/dist/css/colors --no-source-maps --no-cache && shx mv ../neo-npm-package/neo/dist/css/colors/_colors.css ../neo-npm-package/neo/dist/css/colors/neo-colors.css && shx cp neo/neo-scss/tokens/_colors.scss ../neo-npm-package/neo/dist/css/colors/neo-colors.scss
scripts.post-build: shx mkdir -p ../neo-npm-package/neo/dist/css/neo && shx cp ../neo-npm-package/neo.css ../neo-npm-package/neo.min.css && prettier --write ../neo-npm-package/neo.css && shx mv ../neo-npm-package/neo.css ../neo-npm-package/neo.min.css ../neo-npm-package/neo.css.map ../neo-npm-package/neo/dist/css/neo
